title: Motor start with a warning delay
summary: Before a conveyor starts, people nearby must be warned. Pressing Start lights the run lamp as a warning; the motor starts 3 seconds later. Stop cancels at any time.
objectives: Separate a start request from the actual motor command
starterProgram:
PROGRAM Main
VAR_INPUT
    StartPB : BOOL; (* Start button S1, normally open: TRUE while pressed. *)
    StopPB : BOOL; (* Stop button S2, normally closed: TRUE while NOT pressed (wire-break safe). *)
    MotorFeedback : BOOL; (* Contactor auxiliary contact: TRUE when the contactor has pulled in. *)
    OverloadOK : BOOL; (* Overload relay contact, normally closed: TRUE while the motor is not overloaded. *)
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    MotorContactor : BOOL; (* Contactor coil K1: TRUE energizes the motor. *)
    RunLamp : BOOL; (* Green run lamp H1. *)
END_VAR
VAR
    Request : BOOL;
    Delay : TON;
END_VAR

(* Latch a start request, warn with RunLamp, start the motor 3 s later. *)

END_PROGRAM
instructions: Start latches a start request. Stop (StopPB FALSE) or an overload clears it.
RunLamp is on while the request is active (warning and running).
MotorContactor switches on 3 s after the request becomes active, not earlier.
hints: Call the timer every scan: Delay(IN := Request, PT := T#3s);
Use Delay.Q for the motor command.
When Request drops, TON resets its output immediately.

criteria.title: The warning lamp lights at once
criteria.onFail: RunLamp did not light when Start was pressed.

criteria.title: The motor does not start before the delay
criteria.onFail: The motor started before 3 s had elapsed.

criteria.title: The motor starts after 3 s
criteria.onFail: The motor was not running 3.7 s after Start.

criteria.title: Stop cancels the start
criteria.onFail: The motor started although Stop was pressed during the warning.
